provenance.notes: Researched definition in tools/extract/patterns/src/apg-2.mjs. Every binding was checked against the APG page; roles and key names are cross-checked mechanically against apg-skeleton.json and aria-roles.json. Arabic name is an unreviewed translation.

attributes.name: aria-labelledby
attributes.values: IDREF of the visible label; otherwise aria-label

keyboard.action: Into the toolbar: focus the first enabled control on first entry; afterwards optionally the control that last had focus, else the first enabled one. From the toolbar: leave it.
As Tab, backward in the page sequence.
Move focus to the previous control; optionally wrap from first to last.
Move focus to the next control; optionally wrap from last to first.
Move focus to the next control.
Move focus to the previous control.
Move focus to the first control.
Move focus to the last control.

focus.entry: First enabled control, or the last-focused one.
focus.note: Disabled controls are normally skipped; keep them focusable when discovering the function matters. Use a toolbar only for three or more controls. A control that needs the horizontal arrows itself (a text input, a slider) breaks the model and belongs at the end or outside.

rtlDecisions.question: In a horizontal roving-focus composite (tabs, toolbar, menubar, radio group, toggle group), which arrow moves to the next item in RTL?
rtlDecisions.apg: Silent, apart from one aside in the tabs page that calls the last tab the right-most "in a left-to-right horizontal tab list". Keys are named physically: Right Arrow is next.

libraries.behaviour: ArrowLeft is next in RTL for tabs, toolbar and horizontal radio groups; vertical arrows never flip.
The composite root swaps the forward and backward horizontal keys when direction is rtl.
The roving focus group swaps ArrowLeft and ArrowRight before mapping a key to a focus intent when dir is rtl; toggle group, tabs, toolbar, radio group and menubar all pass dir through it.
Tabs and ToggleButtonGroup pass isRtl to the roving tabindex root.
Tabs flip the arrow offset when rtl and the tab bar is top or bottom; a horizontal menu maps Left to next when rtl.

rtlDecisions.reason: Items are laid out from inline-start, so the arrow that points at the visually following item must move to it. All five libraries agree.

data.notes: RTL: ArrowLeft is next and ArrowRight previous in a horizontal toolbar. A radio group nested in the toolbar follows the "inside a toolbar" bindings of radio-group. A text input inside the toolbar keeps its caret keys; the hand-off rule is decision input-edge-handoff.
